title: Figure 2. Atlas IIAS Risk Contours for Inner-Ear Injury with A = 3.0
description: Line map of a coastal launch-area facility layout with roads and plotted sites, overlaid with risk contour lines labeled 10^-6, 10^-5 and 10^-4. A rotated in-figure label reads "Atlas IIAS Inner Ear Injury Mode-5 A = 3.0." Page 11 of a 9/10/96 RTI report.
